query: Saving the 'latent' output of an InfiniteTalk/MultiTalk Long-I2V WanVideoSampler run raises KeyError: 'samples'. Users expected a decodable latent but the sampler stores decoded frames in the latent dict instead.

desired.outcome: kijai (owner) explained: with the Long I2V node there are no latents returned because decode/encode happens inside the loop; the sampler passes through already-decoded images stored in the latent dictionary, so the VAE decode node is a no-op there. User workaround: save the passthrough 'latent' (which already holds images) or re-encode images with the official VAE encoder before saving. Confirmed; closed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
